title: Public/Private Non-Leak Capability-Local Business Ontology Candidate

records.meaning: The private Product whose meaning and authority must remain distinct from the public Arcanum subsystem.
The candidate outcome of evaluating one exact outward change without exposing private meaning or blocking approved public explanation.
Owners receive bounded evidence that one immutable public candidate respects the selected disclosure and withholding policy.
The owner who selects disclosure policy and resolves ambiguous public/private cases.
The owner of the exact public candidate and its canonical-to-generated lineage.
The consumer owner integrating the audit evidence into the continuous Goal frontier.
An agent that may execute deterministic checks and report evidence but cannot decide disclosure or publication.
Immutable base/candidate/diff/path/block/provenance/policy/evidence bundle for one outward Arcanum change.
The exact public bytes proposed for owner review, before publication authority exists.
One normalized added or modified text block with exact byte range and digest.
Owner-bound classification of a changed block as new public, public-derived, approved private-derived, generated, or pre-existing residue.
Immutable owner decision allowing, withholding, or bounding one class of outward meaning.
A policy-selected mechanism or internal meaning that must not be materialized in public bytes or public receipts.
A bounded outward claim whose shipped-state and empirical support do not exceed exact public-safe evidence.
Exact public-safe evidence reference supporting one outward claim without exposing withheld mechanism.
Exact counts and identities for all changed paths, operations, blocks, generated outputs, binary inputs, policy-sensitive inputs, and exclusions.
Composition of compatible scan, provenance, policy, claim, generation, and review evidence preserving the weakest claim and visible unsupported obligations.
Opaque-category result bound to a candidate path/block digest without repeating sensitive matched bytes.
Missing, conflicting, or ambiguous disclosure decision that makes an intersecting check not evaluable.
A pre-existing public occurrence reported separately and forbidden from authorizing new or modified bytes.
The owner-controlled public source from which a generated host projection must deterministically derive.
A non-authoritative public mirror whose canonical source and generator identity are exact.
Private detailed receipt containing exact findings, decisions, paths, and causal not-evaluable checks.
Public-safe projection containing only verdict, policy epoch, candidate digest, counts, and opaque finding IDs.
Active private policy withholds the name while current canonical public Arcanum contains a Necronomicon spell; no superseding selected decision was found.
Broader public disclosure remains open while current public docs contain substantial Craft and CyberAlchemy product prose.
Existing Inventory module scan is path-local, marker-limited, and does not prove repository-wide semantic, provenance, decision, generation, or claim safety.
DomainSpec source, deterministic graph/system ontology, implementation binding, conformance, and mandatory publication-gate adoption remain not evaluable.

Whether contains, classifies, cites, bounds, supported_by, blocks_evaluation_of, accounts_for, preserves_weakest_claim_of, and projects_without_private_detail are admitted relation types
Whether this capability belongs directly to the CyberAlchemy Product or to a dedicated boundary/governance subproduct
Which owner decision supersedes or distinguishes the private Necronomicon name from the current public Arcanum spell
Which exact disclosure decision governs current Craft and CyberAlchemy product prose on public Arcanum Pages
ambient_ontology_drift_policy: Diagnostic unless it intersects the selected_dependencies above; changed, missing, stale, or ambiguous selected bytes remain fail-closed.
claim_ceiling: Endpoint-closed planning candidate only; no canonical-definition promotion, Product Capability adoption, ontology or DomainSpec admission, auditor implementation, policy resolution, public-artifact safety proof, ConstructionBinding, conformance, publication gate, publication, release, deployment, or external effect.
